settings.title: Block ads
settings.summary: Video, feed and video page ads, Boosted videos, Home's ad sections and ad impression reports.

settings.title: Block cookie notice
settings.summary: After restarting: no Ketch consent notice and no consent recorded. Push notifications still work, without Airship's analytics.

settings.title: Clean share links
settings.summary: Removes the query from rumble.com links you share.

settings.title: Disable analytics
settings.summary: Stops Rumble's own event uploads to e.rumble.com and its debug log.

settings.title: Keep watch progress
settings.summary: Still send watch progress events, and only those, which Rumble may use for your watch history. They carry your user ID, advertising ID and AppsFlyer ID.

settings.title: Don't save searches
settings.summary: Searches aren't kept on the phone, and the ones Rumble kept don't show. Clear all in Rumble's search deletes those for good.

settings.title: AMOLED black
settings.summary: Black instead of dark grey for the bottom bar, search fields, cards, chips and tags. Pages, sheets and dialogs are already black; dividers and buttons keep their grey.

settings.title: Near-black surfaces
settings.summary: A black one step lighter (#0B0B0C), so the bottom bar, search fields and cards still stand out from the page.

settings.title: Block update prompts
settings.summary: Rumble's "update required" screen and "new version available" dialog.

settings.title: Default startup tab
settings.summary: The tab Rumble opens on.

settings.title: Hide Create tab
settings.summary: The camera and upload button in the bottom bar.

settings.title: Hide Home sections by title
settings.summary: Section titles to hide, separated by commas, such as Live, Editor Picks. Any case.

settings.title: Hide Join buttons
settings.summary: The Join (channel membership) button on channels and videos.

settings.title: Hide Premium upsells
settings.summary: The Premium sheet, banners and offer, the downloads pitch and live chat gifts.

settings.title: Hide Shop buttons
settings.summary: The Shop button that opens a creator's store, on channels and videos.

settings.title: Hide Shorts
settings.summary: The Shorts tab and rows, and Shorts on channels, categories and search.

settings.title: Hide category rows
settings.summary: Home's rows of categories, such as Top Live Categories.

settings.title: Hide comments
settings.summary: The Comments button under videos, as when a creator turns comments off.

settings.title: Hide creator rows
settings.summary: Home's rows of recommended channels.

settings.title: Hide playlist rows
settings.summary: Home's rows of playlists.

settings.title: Hide premium-only videos
settings.summary: Videos only Premium members can watch, in Home, related videos, search and categories.

settings.title: Hide related videos
settings.summary: The related videos on the video page. Autoplay next video then has nothing to play.

settings.title: Hide tipping and Rants
settings.summary: Tip buttons, Rants and paying with Rumble Wallet.

settings.title: Show exact counts
settings.summary: Views, likes, comments and followers in full, such as 12,345 instead of 12K.

settings.title: Background audio by default
settings.summary: Leaving the app keeps the sound playing, instead of picture-in-picture, until you choose otherwise in Settings > Playback > Background Play.

settings.title: Default playback speed
settings.summary: The speed videos start at until you pick one in the player. Remember playback speed, when on, keeps your pick instead.

settings.title: Default video quality
settings.summary: Until you pick a quality in the player.

settings.title: Live streams too
settings.summary: Start live streams at the default quality instead of Auto. Picking Auto in the player turns this off until you pick a quality on a live stream.

settings.title: On mobile data
settings.summary: The highest quality a video starts at on metered networks. A quality you pick in the player still plays.

settings.title: Fill screen
settings.summary: Zoom videos to fill the screen in landscape, cropping the edges. Not in picture-in-picture.

settings.title: Keep playing during other sounds
settings.summary: What Rumble does when another app plays sound. Calls always pause.

settings.title: Keep screen on while paused
settings.summary: The screen stays on while a video is paused in the player.

settings.title: No autoplay of the next video
settings.summary: Autoplay next video is off unless you turn it on in Settings > Playback.

settings.title: No feed previews
settings.summary: Playback in feeds is off unless you change it in Settings > Playback, and the featured video on Home follows it.

settings.title: Player gestures
settings.summary: In landscape: swipe on the left of the video for brightness, on the right for volume.

settings.title: Refresh stream
settings.summary: Tap the player's error screen to reload the video or stream at the same point.

settings.title: Remember playback speed
settings.summary: Keep the speed you last picked for every video, also after a restart. Live streams without rewind stay at 1x.

settings.title: Resume videos when signed out
settings.summary: Start videos where you left off, from the positions Rumble keeps on the phone.

settings.title: Seek interval
settings.summary: How far the player's rewind and forward buttons skip.

settings.title: Sleep timer
settings.summary: Pauses playback this long after it last started or resumed, including background play.

settings.title: Chat keywords
settings.summary: Highlight and hide live chat messages by the words and users below. Whole words, any case.

settings.title: Highlight mentions
settings.summary: Tint messages that mention your username. Needs a signed-in account.

settings.title: Highlight words
settings.summary: Tint messages containing any of these words or phrases, separated by commas.

settings.title: Vibrate on highlights
settings.summary: Vibrate when a highlighted message arrives in live chat.

settings.title: Blocked words
settings.summary: Hide messages containing any of these words or phrases, separated by commas.

settings.title: Blocked users
settings.summary: Hide messages from these usernames (as in rumble.com/user/name), separated by commas.

settings.title: Chat timestamps
settings.summary: The time each message was sent, before the sender's name.

settings.title: Hide chat badges
settings.summary: Verified, subscriber and supporter badges next to names, and the tint subscribers' messages get. Applies when you open a stream again.

settings.title: Hide gift notices
settings.summary: Chat lines announcing gifted subscriptions.

settings.title: Hide live chat
settings.summary: The whole live chat of every stream. Applies when you open a stream again.

settings.title: Hide pinned messages
settings.summary: The message a channel pins above live chat.

settings.title: Hide raid notices
settings.summary: Chat lines announcing a raid. The raid countdown and Rumble's own Auto-join Raids setting stay.

settings.title: Hide sponsor reads
settings.summary: A creator's sponsor messages in live chat.

settings.title: Show deleted messages
settings.summary: The text of messages moderators removed, after Rumble's "removed by moderator" label.

settings.title: Unlock Premium
settings.summary: Rumble's local premium state; the server still decides premium content. Sign out and in again to apply a change.

settings.title: Debug logging
settings.summary: Detailed lines in the system log for bug reports (adb logcat -s lurk). They can name the channels and videos you open.
